coordination_protocol.independent_assignment: Assign narrow tasks to separate authenticated platforms. Where practical, two reviewers inspect the same core claim independently before seeing one another's conclusion.
coordination_protocol.evidence_exchange: Exchange structured evidence packets only. Preserve exact source URL, source vintage, retrieval time, raw-byte hash, independence group, model eligibility and repository commit.
coordination_protocol.disagreement_resolution: Compare source quality, publisher role, independence, definitions, timestamps, revisions and methodology. Preserve minority objections; do not force unanimity or average incompatible measurements.
coordination_protocol.red_team: A reviewer independent of the leading analysis attempts to falsify the hypothesis and checks leakage, survivorship bias, selection effects, data snooping, regime shifts, source circularity and omitted variables.
coordination_protocol.forecast_handoff: Every forecast candidate carries cutoff, target definition, horizon, probabilities, assumptions, alternative scenarios, baseline, feature snapshot hash, later outcome and scoring/calibration result.
coordination_protocol.authorization: No agent may merge, deploy, rotate secrets, restart Spaces, submit Kaggle entries, paper-trade, transfer funds or use real money without the specific required approval.

least_privilege_policy.research_agents: Read-only public or explicitly authorized sources; no private accounts, secrets or market credentials.
least_privilege_policy.coding_agents: Branch-only repository access after complete duplicate/overlap preflight; no main write, force-push, merge bypass, deployment or secret retrieval.
least_privilege_policy.data_platforms: Dedicated least-privilege service accounts; no public export of private corpora; immutable provenance and audit logs.
least_privilege_policy.market_access: No exchange/broker credentials and no real-money actions. Directional forecasts remain disabled until data and out-of-sample gates pass.
least_privilege_policy.secrets: Never commit API keys, OAuth tokens or credentials to GitHub; use approved provider secret stores only when specifically authorized.

fallback_plan.agent_unavailable: Continue local deterministic work and lawful public-source research; record unavailable platform and observation date.
fallback_plan.provider_rate_limited: Use cached, timestamped snapshots and provider-compliant retry; do not silently substitute a different source.
fallback_plan.dataset_unavailable: Mark the feature missing; do not synthesize, interpolate or backdate.
fallback_plan.agent_disagreement: Retain both positions, source packets, confidence and minority objections; request independent adjudication only when an authenticated reviewer exists.
fallback_plan.platform_failure: Use local SQLite and repository artifacts within current retention limits; do not claim a durable cloud data platform.

agent_review_findings.finding: urllib's default redirect handler could contact the redirect target before the final response URL was checked against the host allowlist.
agent_review_findings.remediation: Reject redirects in a custom HTTPRedirectHandler before any target request; add a local two-server regression test proving the target receives no request.
agent_review_findings.verification: Exact-head full repository CI passed on a18484dbb6cc5924327335f43ef2195188a9f554.

agent_review_findings.finding: The source HTTP Date header used in timestamp reasoning was not preserved in the append-only raw-source receipt.
agent_review_findings.remediation: Persist source_http_date in the receipt; include it in the canonical receipt ID so the captured header is bound to the receipt.
